title: A hater of his kind ran from them to the wood of madness
html_source:
Reference to Jonathan Swift.

Swift (1667-1745) was a misanthropic writer.

The “them” refers to the rabble.

anchor.text: A hater of his kind ran from them to the wood of madness
anchor.prefix: . Beauty is not there. Nor in the stagnant bay of Marsh's library where you read the fading prophecies of Joachim Abbas. For whom? The hundredheaded rabble of the cathedral close.
anchor.suffix: , his mane foaming in the moon, his eyeballs stars. Houyhnhnm, horsenostrilled. The oval equine faces, Temple, Buck Mulligan, Foxy Campbell, Lanternjaws. Abbas father,—furious dean
